أحمد بن الحسن بن علي بن فضال

notes: The first level is three co-transmitters joined by «و» and closed by «قالوا»: one level, not three routes.
The bracketed «[عن الحسن بن علي بن فضال]» is the text's own editorial insertion; it is read as written (occurrence 2).
The Imam speaks after «قال: سمعت» (rule 5): he is the last link, kind imam_in_text.
